insize.description: Pre-allocate and fill inbuf size. Accepts integers or strings with multipliers (e.g., '16k', '16KiB', '16384').

outsize.description: Pre-allocate outbuf size. Accepts integers or strings with multipliers (e.g., '512m', '512MiB', '536870912').

nofill.description: If true, do not pass a fill function. Requires insize to be set.

noflush.description: If true, do not pass a flush function. Requires outsize to be set.
